_why: 3.6 step 2: only an attack-roll or save cantrip with enemy lines (or Poison Spray) becomes an enemy's base attack (apply_enemy_spell_base). True Strike is an effect cantrip with no enemy lines, so a swordsman given it keeps the sword and spell_base_id stays empty. (It was Vicious Mockery until that got enemy lines, 3.6 step 5.)
